evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
プレイヤーは帆船を指揮する船長となり
自らの船を駆って果てしない大海原へと
漕ぎ出していきます。
　
ネットワーク上に構築された世界に
集まった仲間たちと艦隊を組み
隠された古代の秘法にまつわる謎解きを
したり、海賊船団との手に汗握る戦闘を
繰り広げたりと、新しい世界に向かって
冒険の航海を続けていきます。

source_draft.english:
Take command of your own sailing ship and set out across a boundless ocean.

Form a fleet with other sailors you meet online. Unravel mysteries tied to hidden ancient arts, fight tense battles against pirate fleets, and keep sailing toward a new world of adventure.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
「大航海時代Ｏｎｌｉｎｅ」は
16世紀初頭にヨーロッパで巻き起こった
一大ムーブメント“大航海時代”の世界
を舞台に、冒険家や商人、軍人などに
成り代わり、同じ世界に生きる様々な
人々との人間ドラマを創り上げていく
オンライン海洋冒険ロールプレイング
ゲームです。

source_draft.english: Uncharted Waters Online is a seafaring adventure RPG set in the Age of Discovery, which swept through Europe in the early 1500s. Step into the role of an adventurer, a merchant, or a soldier and make your own stories with the people who share your world.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
本作のサーバ世界は、ポルトガルや
イスパニア、イングランドなど複数の
国々で構成され、プレイヤーは、自分の
分身であるプレイヤーキャラクターを
作成する際に、どの国の出身かを選択
することになります。
　
それぞれ出身国の本拠地となるリスボン
やセビリア、ロンドンといった賑やかな
港街を舞台に冒険家、商人、軍人
いずれかの道を選び、航海者としての
人生をスタートさせます。

source_draft.english:
The online world spans Portugal, Spain, England, and more. Choose a homeland when you create your character.

Start your seafaring life as an adventurer, merchant, or soldier in a bustling home port such as Lisbon, Seville, or London.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese: 自由な生き方が可能

source_draft.english: Live Life Your Way

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
プレイ開始当初は出身国を中心に活動し
新たな港や交易品などの探索をします。
近海エリアの地勢が明らかになると
交易品の売買や海賊の討伐などを行い
ながら、船乗りとしての能力を高め
徐々に船足が速く、大きく、頑丈な船を
操ることができるようになります。
そして、他のプレイヤーと協力しながら
ギルドの依頼をこなすことで航海者と
しての名声を上げたり、投資によって
所属する国家の同盟港を増やしたりと
プレイヤーの自由な選択によって
様々な生き方ができます。

source_draft.english: Explore the ports and goods near your homeland first. Once you know the local waters, trade goods and hunt pirates to hone your seamanship. In time, you can command faster, larger, and sturdier ships. Work with other players on guild assignments to build your reputation, or invest to bring more ports into your nation's alliance. How you make your way at sea is up to you.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese: 国王からの勅命を受け、さらなる冒険へ

source_draft.english: Royal Orders Lead to New Adventures

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
国王からの勅命を受ければ、新たな航海
エリアを開拓することができ、さらなる
冒険へと旅立つことになります。
　
異文化の街並みで手に入る珍しい衣装や
産物、広大な陸地の奥にそびえ建つ
遺跡とそこに眠る秘宝、容赦なく艦隊の
行く手を阻む嵐、プレイヤー自らが私掠
海賊となれる危険海域など、スリルと
スペクタクルにあふれた航海が、船乗り
たちを待ち受けているのです。

source_draft.english:
Orders from the king open new waters and send you on new adventures.

In foreign towns you can find rare clothing and goods, and deep inland, great ruins hold hidden treasures. Storms can stop your fleet in its tracks, and in dangerous waters you can become a privateer yourself. A life at sea is full of thrills and sights to see.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
世界の海を舞台に
　　　　船乗りとして自由に生きる！

source_draft.english: Live Your Own Way at Sea!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
用意されている職業は50種類以上！
冒険、交易、戦闘の３系統に分かれて
おり、航海者として経験を積むことで
該当するギルドでの転職が可能に
なります。転職を行うと獲得できる
スキルの種類や、成長の仕方が大きく
変化していきます。

source_draft.english: Choose from 50 or more professions across three fields: adventure, trade, and combat. Once you have some experience at sea, visit the guild for your chosen field to change professions. A change of profession can make a big difference to which skills you learn and how your character develops.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
広大な海の彼方へ漕ぎ出し
　　　 偉大な冒険家として名を刻め！

source_draft.english: Sail Far and Make Your Name as an Explorer!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
荘厳な巨大遺跡、伝説の宝物、未知
なる生命、自然の驚異…。
フル３Ｄで実現された広大な世界には
無数の謎が隠されており、冒険家たちは
互いに協力しながら、偉大な発見を
追い求めます。

source_draft.english: Towering ruins, legendary treasures, unfamiliar creatures, and wonders of nature await. This vast 3D world holds countless mysteries. Team up with other adventurers and set out to make great discoveries.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
多彩な交易品を売買し
　　　　　楽しみながらひと儲け

source_draft.english: Trade All Kinds of Goods and Turn a Profit!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
売買される交易品は数百種類以上。
商人たちの取引によって相場は絶えず
変化し、仮想世界内の経済を形作ります
　
さらに、世界中の街に投資することで
出身国の同盟港とし、有利な条件で
交易したり、新たな特産品を品揃えに
加えたりすることも
できます。

source_draft.english:
There are hundreds of goods to buy and sell. The deals merchants make keep prices moving and shape the economy.

Invest in towns around the world to bring them into your homeland's alliance. You may earn better terms and find new local specialties for sale.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
ひとたび街を出港すれば、そこは海賊が
出没する危険な海。軍人は冒険家や商人
を護衛しながら海賊を倒し名声を高めて
いきます。
また、プレイヤー同士が海賊団を結成
することももちろん可能。
砲撃や白兵戦等を駆使した艦隊同士の
熱き戦いはまさに大航海時代の花形です

source_draft.english: Pirates lurk in the waters outside port. As a soldier, you can earn a name for yourself by escorting adventurers and merchants and defeating pirates. You and other players can even form a pirate fleet. Cannon fire and hand-to-hand fighting make fleet battles a highlight of the Age of Discovery.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese: 所属国で大きく変化するストーリー！

source_draft.english: Your Nation Shapes Your Story!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
ヨーロッパ各国を起点に、様々な冒険が
スタート！
ギルドの依頼を達成したり、航海での
発見を報告したりして、航海者としての
名声を高めれば、国王からの勅命が下り
新たな海域への航海許可を得ることが
ことができます。
旅先では様々なイベントキャラクターが
登場し、それぞれ所属する国家の情勢に
応じたストーリーが展開します。

source_draft.english: Set out from one of the nations of Europe. Complete guild assignments and report your discoveries to build your reputation as a seafarer. The king can then issue orders allowing you to sail in new waters. You'll meet all kinds of characters in your travels, and their stories unfold according to what's happening in your nation.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
絶えず変化しつづける世界が
　　バラエティに富んだ冒険を生み出す！

source_draft.english: A Changing World Brings New Adventures!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
仮想世界はプレイヤー1人1人の行動に
影響され、絶えず変化します。
　
例えば、同盟港をめぐって、王の勅命に
より大海戦が発生したり、プレイヤーの
交易によって相場が大きく変動します。

source_draft.english: The virtual world changes constantly in response to each player's actions. Royal orders can spark great naval battles over allied ports, while players' trading can cause dramatic shifts in market prices.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
街で出会った仲間とともに
　　　　冒険の旅に出発！

source_draft.english: Set Sail with Companions You Meet in Town!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
航海の目的となる依頼を街のギルドで
手にしたら、他のプレイヤーを誘い
艦隊を編成します。
旅の途中協力して街で聞き込みをしたり
製図や考古学といったメンバーの持つ
スキルを利用して謎解きをしたり
しながら、偉大な発見を目指して互いに
協力していきます。
途中、洋上で沈む夕日を共に眺めたり
旅先の酒場で共に語らう楽しさも、また
格別です。

source_draft.english: Pick up a voyage assignment from a guild and invite other players to form a fleet. Ask around in towns and use your companions' skills, such as cartography and archaeology, to unravel mysteries and make great discoveries. A shared sunset at sea or a good talk in a tavern is its own reward along the way.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
自分だけのオリジナル船で
　　　　 大海原を駆けめぐる！

source_draft.english: Sail the Open Seas in a Ship All Your Own!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
船には大小様々なタイプがあり、材質や
武装、帆の数や紋章などを変更して
自分だけの船を作ることができます。
　
また、キャラクターの体型や髪型は
もちろん、当時の提督や貴族たちが愛用
した衣服や帽子など数百種類の装備品が
用意され、思い思いのいでたちで街中を
闊歩できます。

source_draft.english: Ships come in many types and sizes. Change their materials, weapons, number of sails, and emblems to create a vessel of your own. Customize your character's build and hairstyle, then choose from hundreds of items, including the clothes and hats favored by admirals and nobles of the age. Stroll through town in whatever style suits you.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese: 当時の世界を忠実に再現した冒険空間！

source_draft.english: Explore the World as It Was in the Age of Discovery!

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
地域や時間に応じて多彩な表情を見せる
海を、壮大かつ美しく再現。
旅の途中で訪れる各都市には、ピサの
斜塔やパルテノン神殿など街の象徴が
そびえます。
街の城門や上陸地点から内陸へと探検も
可能。ナイル川をさかのぼったり
ピラミッドを発掘したりと、冒険の
舞台は限りなく広がります。

source_draft.english: The sea comes to life in all its grandeur and beauty, changing with the region and time of day. In port, you'll see landmarks like the Leaning Tower of Pisa and the Parthenon. Head inland through a city gate or from a landing site. Sail up the Nile, excavate pyramids, and see how far your adventures take you.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese: Ｏｎｌｉｎｅ版とのタイアップについて

source_draft.english: About the Online Tie-In

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
『大航海時代Ⅳ ＲＯＴＡ ＮＯＶＡ』は
Ｗｉｎｄｏｗｓ版『大航海時代
Ｏｎｌｉｎｅ』とタイアップして
ゲームの楽しさを広げる機能を
提供します。

source_draft.english: Uncharted Waters IV: Rota Nova offers extra ways to enjoy the game through a tie-in with the Windows edition of Uncharted Waters Online.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.display_disposition: Open for the distinct COMMON wording or fuller text.

evidenced_related_but_distinct.clean_Japanese:
Ｗｉｎｄｏｗｓ版『大航海時代
Ｏｎｌｉｎｅ』に入会されてクエストを
達成すると、村の名とセットになった
パスワードを獲得することができます。
　
『大航海時代Ⅳ ＲＯＴＡ ＮＯＶＡ』で
指定された村まで航海し、獲得した
パスワードを使うと村に新たな交易品が
登場し、交易が可能になります。

source_draft.english:
Join the Windows edition of Uncharted Waters Online and complete a quest to receive a village name and its Promised Words.

Sail to that village in Uncharted Waters IV: Rota Nova and enter the Promised Words. You can then trade for new goods in the village.

chooser_biographies.source_meaning: A Portuguese boy vaguely dreams of being a sailor. A friend persuades him to go to sea. Recommended for people playing for the first time.
chooser_biographies.english: A Portuguese boy dreams of the sea. A friend talks him into setting sail. Great for first-time players.
chooser_biographies.localization_note: Retain the boy's quiet dream of the sea and the advice for beginners. The friend talks him into setting sail, without assigning a worldwide itinerary to the friend's suggestion.

chooser_biographies.localization_note: Restore the regained independence and the gulf between the title of navy and the privateers he actually leads. 'Second to none' expresses his ambition for the fleet in the same brisk third-person voice.

online_pages.english: A sailor's life around the world
online_pages.localization_note: Use an idiomatic title for the promise of a sailor’s life with the world as its setting.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 世界を舞台に、船乗りとして生きる

observed_native_draw.text: A sailor's life around the world

online_pages.source_meaning: Sail beyond the sea and make a name for yourself.
online_pages.localization_note: Making a mark preserves the invitation to earn renown without promising a place in history.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 海の彼方へ漕ぎ出し、名を刻め！

online_pages.source_meaning: Earn money by buying and selling a variety of trade goods.
online_pages.english: Trade varied goods for a profit!
online_pages.localization_note: The line preserves the variety of goods and the chance to earn a profit without promising a fortune.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 多彩な交易品を売買してひと儲け！

observed_native_draw.text: Trade varied goods for a profit!

online_pages.localization_note: The caption carries the excitement of the original sea battle alongside its image.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 洋上で繰り広げられる、熱き戦い！

online_pages.context: Online Version, First Steps, page 1 of 2.
online_pages.source_meaning: The story changes greatly with the nation you belong to.
online_pages.localization_note: The choice of nation has a major effect on the story. The active caption already expresses that relationship.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 所属国で大きく変わるストーリー！

online_pages.context: Online Version, First Steps, page 2 of 2.
online_pages.source_meaning: Changes bring an excitement unlike anything before.
online_pages.localization_note: The caption carries the new excitement that follows changes without adding a particular event or cause.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 変化が生み出すかつてない刺激！

online_pages.context: Online Version, Create a Story, page 1 of 3.
online_pages.source_meaning: Set off on an adventure with companions you have met.
online_pages.localization_note: The page describes forming a fleet with people the player meets. Companions fits that relationship without implying a political alliance.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 出会った仲間とともに冒険に出発！

online_pages.context: Online Version, Create a Story, page 2 of 3.
online_pages.source_meaning: Race across the open sea in your own ship.
online_pages.english: Sail far in your own ship!
online_pages.localization_note: The caption preserves the emphasis on the player’s own ship and the scope of the voyage.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 自分だけの船で大海原を駆けろ！

observed_native_draw.text: Sail far in your own ship!

online_pages.context: Online Version, Create a Story, page 3 of 3.
online_pages.source_meaning: A grand, thrilling world of adventure.
online_pages.localization_note: The vast adventure and its enthusiasm carry the closing caption’s meaning.
online_pages.source_Japanese: 胸がおどる壮大な冒険空間！

about_extras_pages.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
about_extras_pages.source_meaning: Introduces the tie-in with the PC game Uncharted Waters Online. Playing both games expands what you can do in Rota Nova.
about_extras_pages.english: Learn about this game's tie-in with the PC title Uncharted Waters Online. Playing both games opens new ways to enjoy this game.
about_extras_pages.localization_note: The introduction already identifies the other game and makes clear that the tie-in adds something to this game.
about_extras_pages.source_Japanese:
パソコン版ゲームソフト
『大航海時代 Online』との
タイアップについて紹介します。
『大航海時代 Online』を
あわせてプレイすることで、
本製品の楽しさが広がります。
english_lines: new ways to enjoy this game.

about_extras_pages.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
about_extras_pages.source_meaning: Play the Online game and learn the village name and its password by speaking with a particular character.
about_extras_pages.english: STEP 1{LB}Play Uncharted Waters Online. A certain character will tell you a village name and its Promised Words.
about_extras_pages.localization_note: The paired name and password lead directly into Step 2. Use Promised Words, the name shown by the village interface.
about_extras_pages.source_Japanese:
ＳＴＥＰ１
まずは『大航海時代 Online』を
プレイして、特定のキャラクター
から「村の名前」と
「約束の言葉」を聞き出します。
english_lines: you a village name and its

about_extras_pages.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
about_extras_pages.source_meaning: Find that village in this game and use the password to trade with the village. Valuable trade goods become available.
about_extras_pages.english: STEP 2{LB}Find that village in Rota Nova and enter its Promised Words. You can then trade for valuable new goods.
about_extras_pages.localization_note: Identify Rota Nova as the game the player returns to, preserve the password term, and keep the new goods as trade goods.
about_extras_pages.source_Japanese:
ＳＴＥＰ２
本製品で、その「村」を探し当て
「約束の言葉」を使うと、
「村」との交易が可能になり
高価な交易品が登場します。
english_lines: Find that village in Rota Nova

about_extras_pages.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
about_extras_pages.source_meaning: There are 24 villages in all, and the trade goods that appear differ by village. The text invites the player to see them in person.
about_extras_pages.english: There are 24 villages, each with its own trade goods. Visit them to see what they sell.
about_extras_pages.localization_note: Keep all 24 villages and their different goods. This refers to commodities for sale and the invitation to explore.
about_extras_pages.source_Japanese:
「村」は全部で２４カ所。
登場する交易品も「村」ごとに
異なります。
どんな交易品が登場するか、
ぜひ、あなたの目で確かめて
ください。

about_extras_pages.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
about_extras_pages.source_meaning: The closing invitation directs players to the official website of Uncharted Waters Online to continue their voyages.
about_extras_pages.english: Visit the official Uncharted Waters Online site and set sail again!
about_extras_pages.localization_note: Restore the word official and the full game title. Treat the invitation as the original game’s copy.
about_extras_pages.source_Japanese:
さあ、『大航海時代 Online』
公式サイトにアクセスして
さらなる航海の旅へ！

about_extras_pages.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
about_extras_pages.source_meaning: Depending on circumstances, network content services may change or end. The message asks players to keep that in mind.
about_extras_pages.english: Please note that online services may change or end.
about_extras_pages.localization_note: Keep the service caveat. The Japanese does not say changes will happen without notice.
about_extras_pages.source_Japanese:
都合により、ネットワーク
コンテンツのサービスを変更
終了する場合があります。
ご了承ください。
